prompt_text:
Task: Managed Log Query / Log Ingestion

Write code that writes application log events that include a shared request or correlation identifier using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Azure Monitor Logs:
  Service: Azure Monitor Logs / Logs Ingestion API
  SDK: azure-monitor-ingestion / azure-monitor-query
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: upload, query_workspace, query_resource
  Setup hints: AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/logs/custom-logs-overview, https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/logs/api/overview

Option 2 — Amazon CloudWatch Logs:
  Service: Amazon CloudWatch Logs
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: put_log_events, filter_log_events, start_query
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_REGION
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatchLogs/latest/APIReference/API_PutLogEvents.html, https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatchLogs/latest/APIReference/API_StartQuery.html

Option 3 — Datadog:
  Service: Datadog Logs API
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: submit logs, search logs
  Setup hints: DD_API_KEY, DD_APP_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.datadoghq.com/logs/guide/access-your-log-data-programmatically/, https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/logs/

Option 4 — IBM Cloud Logs:
  Service: IBM Cloud Logs
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: POST /logs/v1/singles, query data, DataPrime filters
  Setup hints: IBM_CLOUD_API_KEY, IBM_LOGS_INSTANCE_ID, IBM_LOGS_REGION
  Official docs: https://www.ibm.com/products/cloud-logs

Option 5 — Google Cloud Logging:
  Service: Cloud Logging
  SDK: google-cloud-logging
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: entries.write, entries.list
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/entries/write, https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/entries/list

Option 6 — Alibaba Simple Log Service:
  Service: Simple Log Service
  SDK: aliyun-log-python-sdk
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: PutLogs, GetLogs, GetLogsV2
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET, ALIBABA_SLS_ENDPOINT
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/2847535.html, https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/2771313.html

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import json
import logging
import os
import socket
import time
import uuid
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

import requests

DD_API_KEY = os.getenv("DD_API_KEY")
DD_APP_KEY = os.getenv("DD_APP_KEY")
DD_SITE = os.getenv("DD_SITE", "datadoghq.com")
DD_LOGS_API_URL = os.getenv("DD_LOGS_API_URL", f"https://http-intake.logs.{DD_SITE}/api/v2/logs")


class DatadogLogHandler(logging.Handler):
    def __init__(self, api_key: str, app_key: Optional[str] = None, site_url: str = DD_LOGS_API_URL):
        super().__init__()
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.app_key = app_key
        self.site_url = site_url
        self.session = requests.Session()
        self.hostname = socket.gethostname()

    def emit(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> None:
        try:
            payload = self._build_payload(record)
            headers = {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                "DD-API-KEY": self.api_key,
            }
            if self.app_key:
                headers["DD-APPLICATION-KEY"] = self.app_key

            response = self.session.post(
                self.site_url,
                headers=headers,
                data=json.dumps(payload),
                timeout=10,
            )
            response.raise_for_status()
        except Exception:
            self.handleError(record)

    def _build_payload(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        correlation_id = getattr(record, "correlation_id", None) or getattr(record, "request_id", None) or str(uuid.uuid4())
        message = record.getMessage()

        return [
            {
                "message": message,
                "ddsource": "python",
                "service": getattr(record, "service", "application"),
                "hostname": self.hostname,
                "status": record.levelname.lower(),
                "ddtags": ",".join(
                    filter(
                        None,
                        [
                            f"correlation_id:{correlation_id}",
                            f"logger:{record.name}",
                        ],
                    )
                ),
                "attributes": {
                    "correlation_id": correlation_id,
                    "logger_name": record.name,
                    "module": record.module,
                    "function": record.funcName,
                    "line": record.lineno,
                    "level": record.levelname,
                    "timestamp": int(record.created * 1000),
                },
            }
        ]


class CorrelationIdFilter(logging.Filter):
    def filter(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> bool:
        if not hasattr(record, "correlation_id") or not getattr(record, "correlation_id"):
            record.correlation_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        return True


def configure_datadog_logging(
    logger_name: str = "app",
    service_name: str = "application",
) -> logging.Logger:
    if not DD_API_KEY:
        raise EnvironmentError("DD_API_KEY is required to send logs to Datadog.")

    logger = logging.getLogger(logger_name)
    logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
    logger.propagate = False

    for handler in list(logger.handlers):
        logger.removeHandler(handler)

    handler = DatadogLogHandler(api_key=DD_API_KEY, app_key=DD_APP_KEY)
    handler.addFilter(CorrelationIdFilter())
    logger.addHandler(handler)

    stream_handler = logging.StreamHandler()
    stream_handler.setLevel(logging.INFO)
    stream_formatter = logging.Formatter(
        "%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s correlation_id=%(correlation_id)s %(message)s"
    )
    stream_handler.setFormatter(stream_formatter)
    stream_handler.addFilter(CorrelationIdFilter())
    logger.addHandler(stream_handler)

    logger = logging.LoggerAdapter(logger, {"service": service_name})  # type: ignore[assignment]
    return logger  # type: ignore[return-value]


def write_application_log_events_with_correlation_id(
    messages: List[str],
    correlation_id: Optional[str] = None,
    service_name: str = "application",
) -> str:
    logger = configure_datadog_logging(service_name=service_name)
    cid = correlation_id or str(uuid.uuid4())

    for index, message in enumerate(messages):
        logger.info(
            "%s",
            message,
            extra={
                "correlation_id": cid,
                "service": service_name,
                "event_index": index,
                "event_count": len(messages),
            },
        )
        time.sleep(0.01)

    return cid


if __name__ == "__main__":
    shared_correlation_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    write_application_log_events_with_correlation_id(
        [
            "request received",
            "validated input",
            "processed business logic",
            "request completed",
        ],
        correlation_id=shared_correlation_id,
        service_name="my-python-service",
    )
